rules.accepted_credit_types: CE approved by a recognized approval body; 1 contact hour = 60 minutes, 1 CEU = 10 contact hours, 1 semester credit = 15 contact hours
rules.alternatives: Current national certification (e.g. ANCC) uploaded to CE Broker covers all CE for both the APRN and the RN license, except the non-cancer pain management hours for DEA holders.

topics.who: APRNs who prescribe controlled substances and hold a DEA registration; non-cancer pain management (16.12.9.10 NMAC)

rules.notes: The 5 contact hours apply only to APRNs with a DEA registration; others meet CE through national certification. APRNs need both an APRN and an RN account in CE Broker. Hours are prorated if the licensing period is under 24 months.
